synthesis.body: tools/build-site.py rewrites an unresolvable in-tree Markdown link into an external GitHub blob locator, which moves it out of tools/check-rendered-site-links.py's scope because that audit checks internal links only. A mistyped in-repo link therefore ships as an external 404 while the gate stays green. Measured on 2026-09-09: guides/desk-research/ carried six unresolvable relative .md links -- README.md naming how-to/desk-research-pipelines.md and explanation/desk-research-methodology.md when the files are research-pipelines.md and research-methodology.md, and your-first-research-project.md naming research-first-session.md when the file is desk-research-first-session.md -- while make site-link-check reported 73,075 links across 288 pages clean. The emitted page carried an external blob locator pointing back at the non-existent guides/ path. Detect this class from both sides: walk authored guides/ links against the filesystem, and assert no emitted page carries an external blob locator pointing back under guides/. A clean site-link-check is not evidence that in-tree guide links resolve.

title: build-site.py rewrites an unresolvable in-tree link into an external blob URL, out of the link audit's scope
